[Act: constitution
 Chapter: The Union and its Territory
 Section: 1::Name and territory of the Union
]


(1)India, that is Bharat, shall be a Union of States.
(2)1[The States and the territories thereof shall be as specified in the First Schedule.]
(3)The territory of India shall comprise—
(a)the territories of the States;
(b)2[the Union territories specified in the First Schedule; and]
(c)such other territories as may be acquired.

metadata.section_title: Name and territory of the Union
